children: Universal Vapor Jet Corporation will debut NovaJet, its first commercial system using Universal Vapor Jet Printing, at WESEMiBAY in Shenzhen on Oct 14–16, 2026.
First commercial tool signals move from R&D to potential revenue generation.
Targets key Asia semiconductor ecosystem, aiding customer adoption.
Could cut steps vs lithography, improving cost/yield for adopters.
Enables deposition on delicate, non-planar, temperature-sensitive parts.
Expands use cases across semis, packaging, electronics, energy.

This is an early-stage commercialization step for UDC’s UVJC, signaling progress from lab tech to manufacturable tools. A signed evaluation, pilot order, or production purchase from a recognized semiconductor customer would turn this into a larger catalyst.
